questions.question: Can one cond branch return a scalar and the other a length-three array?
options: No, branch result types and shapes must be compatible
Only if the predicate is negative
questions.explanation: Compiled control flow requires compatible output structures and array types across branches.
optionFeedback: Both branches are traced into one conditional contract. A scalar and a length-three vector cannot be alternative results of that contract.
Compiled control flow requires compatible output structures and array types across branches.
The sign selects the runtime branch but does not remove the need to trace and type-check the other branch.
